property_summary: After any user withdraws their balance, the contract's ETH balance must still equal the balances of the other depositors (the reentrancy lock makes the re-entrant inner withdrawal revert); the mutant lets the re-entrant withdrawal drain those funds too, leaving address(c).balance too low.
change_summary: Delete `locked_ = true;` in the nonReentrant_ modifier so the mutex is never set, allowing reentrant calls to withdrawBalance to execute.
